name: @geld/extension
description: Browser extension that hides test files (and other noise) from GitHub diffs.
author: Brandon McConnell

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:edge && pnpm run build:safari
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.zip:all: pnpm run zip:chrome && pnpm run zip:firefox && pnpm run zip:edge && pnpm run zip:safari
scripts.safari:project: pnpm run build:safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter .output/safari-mv3 --project-location safari --app-name Geld --bundle-identifier sh.geld.safari --no-open --copy-resources
